messages:
Sam: Heads-up — saw a 15-25% p50/p95 regression on canary model v2 compared to baseline v1 for /api/v1/chat-complete. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/ABxyz :grimacing:

monitoring-bot: ALERT: increase in token_latency_total for route=/api/v1/chat-complete, model=canary-v2, region=us-east-1. alert_id=alert-20260317-01

Anya: Is this from kernel change or batching config? Recent change set: kernel selector now prefers 'fast-attn' when seq<=256 (merged in runtime/main @ 2026-03-16).

Jordan: I profiled a few requests from the canary pool — token breakdown (median) below:
```
Token level breakdown (median)
- KV lookup: 0.9ms
- Kernel compute: 3.4ms
- KV write: 0.6ms
- Batch wait: 2.1ms
- Network: 0.4ms
Total per-token: 7.4ms
```

Devon: KV cache hit rate dropped from ~98% -> ~82% on canary traffic. Looks like prefix mismatch from the new prompt-normalizer; that increases KV lookups which in turn increases batch wait.

Sam: Route-level KPI shows canary got 10% traffic. GPU util roughly the same but tokens-per-request for canary is +8%. p95 token latency jumped most on longer sequences >200.

Jordan: Perf trace shows kernel selection fallback path happening intermittently — every ~10th token we hit a fallback to generic attention kernel due to mask shape change. Trace snippet: ```trace_id=abc123 fallback_count=12 fallback_reason=mask_shape_mismatch```

Anya: Proposal: add token-level panels on the model-compare dashboard: kernel-fallback-rate, batch_wait_ms, kv_hit_rate (per-model), plus per-route median & p95. Also surface batching-window histogram.

deploy-bot: Canary routing config unchanged. No automated rollback. Reaction :thinking_face:

Devon: I'll push a quick batching heuristics patch (cap adaptive-window to 6ms and tweak min-batch-size heuristics) and add extra KV metrics emission (kv.hit and kv.miss per-request). Will also add fine-grained histogram buckets for token_latency_ms (0.1ms buckets up to 50ms).

Sam: Sounds good. Assigning: @Devon to patch runtime batching, @Jordan to add dashboard panels and queries, @Anya to validate profiling and kernel-selector tests. Please post back perf numbers after the canary ramp.

Jordan: Dashboard PR opened: https://redwood.internal/graphs/pull/789 — includes per-route KPIs, token-level breakdown panels, and model-version comparison (canary vs baseline). PromQL snippets included in PR for kernel_fallback_rate and batch_wait_ms.

monitoring-bot: NOTE: alert resolved for now (kv-hit-rate increased after fix deployment). Keep monitoring for the next 2 hours.

Sam: Thanks all. Let's keep the canary at 10% for 1 more hour and gather p50/p95 token-levels and kv-hit-rate by model-version. If regressions persist, rollback plan B is ready.
